org.h2.api.summary: Contains interfaces for user-defined extensions, such as triggers and user-defined aggregate functions.

org.h2.bnf.summary: The implementation of the BNF (Backus-Naur form) parser and tool.

org.h2.bnf.context.summary: Classes that provide context for the BNF tool, in order to provide BNF-based auto-complete.

org.h2.command.summary: This package contains the parser and the base classes for prepared SQL statements.

org.h2.command.ddl.summary: Contains DDL (data definition language) and related SQL statements.

org.h2.command.dml.summary: Contains DML (data manipulation language) and related SQL statements.

org.h2.constraint.summary: Database constraints such as check constraints, unique constraints, and referential constraints.

org.h2.engine.summary: Contains high level classes of the database and classes that don't fit in another sub-package.

org.h2.expression.summary: Expressions include mathematical operations, simple values, and others.

org.h2.expression.analysis.summary: Base classes for data analysis operations and implementations of window functions.

org.h2.fulltext.summary: The native full text search implementation, and the wrapper for the Lucene full text search implementation.

org.h2.index.summary: Various table index implementations, as well as cursors to navigate in an index.

org.h2.jdbc.meta.summary: Implementation of the JDBC database metadata API (package {

org.h2.jdbcx.summary: Implementation of the extended JDBC API (package {

org.h2.jmx.summary: Implementation of the Java Management Extension (JMX) features.

org.h2.message.summary: Trace (logging facility) and error message tool.

org.h2.mode.summary: Utility classes for compatibility with other database, for example MySQL.

org.h2.mvstore.summary: A persistent storage for tree maps.

org.h2.mvstore.db.summary: Helper classes to use the MVStore in the H2 database.

org.h2.mvstore.tx.summary: Helper classes to use the MVStore in a transactional manner.

org.h2.result.summary: Implementation of row and internal result sets.

org.h2.schema.summary: Schema implementation and objects that are stored in a schema (for example, sequences and constants).

org.h2.security.summary: Security classes, such as encryption and cryptographically secure hash algorithms.

org.h2.server.pg.summary: PostgreSQL server implementation of this database.

org.h2.store.fs.disk.summary: This file system stores files on disk.

org.h2.store.fs.mem.summary: This file system keeps files fully in memory.

org.h2.store.fs.niomapped.summary: This file system stores files on disk and uses {

org.h2.store.fs.niomem.summary: This file system keeps files fully in off-java-heap memory.

org.h2.store.fs.rec.summary: A file system that records all write operations and can re-play them.

org.h2.store.fs.zip.summary: A zip-file base file system abstraction.
